description: Configure region, area, operator, and status filters to extract offshore well inventory records from the BSEE Data Center's official API List.

areaCode.description: BSEE surface area code to include (e.g. "MC" for Mississippi Canyon, "GC" for Green Canyon), as published in the source data. Empty means all areas.
areaCode.title: Surface Area Code (Optional)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of well records to extract.
maxItems.title: Max Wells

operatorContains.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the operator (company) name as published, e.g. "Shell". Empty means all operators.
operatorContains.title: Operator Name Contains (Optional)

regions.description: BSEE OCS region codes to include: "G" (Gulf of Mexico), "P" (Pacific), "Y" (Alaska), "A" (Atlantic). Empty means all regions in the inventory.
regions.title: Regions (Optional)

statusCodes.description: Borehole status codes to include, as published in the source data (e.g. ["COM", "PA"]). Empty means all statuses.
statusCodes.title: Borehole Status Codes (Optional)

title: US Offshore Well Inventory Input
